name: DELUSION
description: False belief maintained despite contrary evidence; a stuck pattern fed back without perturbation. Anti-pharmacy mode: reinforcement of what should be challenged

name: DEPENDENCE
description: Reliance on external support that reduces autonomy; the relationship that weakens rather than strengthens. Anti-pharmacy mode: the medicine that makes the patient need more medicine

name: PARASOCIAL
description: One-sided relationship perceived as mutual; substitution of imagined connection for genuine human bond. Anti-pharmacy mode: replacing human connection rather than deepening capacity for it
